verdict.rationale: Motion's own feature pages describe sharing your schedule so prospects can book slots instantly, branded meeting links, and availability drawn from all connected Outlook/Google/iCloud calendars so you never get double-booked. Together these deliver self-serve booking from live availability with no email back-and-forth. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the booking-link flow (the evidence is marketing copy only), and independent or hands-on corroboration that invitees see real-time availability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can share a booking link where invitees pick a time from my live availability — no back-and-forth email

citations.quote: Share your schedule anywhere—embed Motion's AI Calendar on your website so prospects can book your ideal time slots instantly.
Customize meeting names, location details, and create branded meeting links.
Turn all of your calendar accounts—Outlook, Google, iCloud—into one single interface. Never get double-booked
When you hit your threshold, your calendar becomes unbookable
Create custom availability in seconds with an intuitive drag-and-drop interface
